title: Local testing of a dictator subclass
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates. The tester formed by choosing uniformly between the BLR–NAE tester and the local correction tester for $S$ has positive rate $1/100$: it accepts every function equal to a coordinate projection on some coordinate in $S$ with probability $1$, and, for every $0\leq\varepsilon\leq1$, it rejects with probability greater than $\varepsilon/100$ every function whose relative Hamming distance from each such coordinate projection is greater than $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
the rate is $1/100$ and is positive
every function in the specified dictator subclass is accepted with probability $1$
the tested function is at relative Hamming distance greater than $\varepsilon$ from every function in the subclass
the rejection probability is greater than $\varepsilon/100$
